verdict.rationale: Navan is a travel and expense platform, so multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, never mentions multiple legal entities, multi-currency handling, consolidated reporting or per-entity books. ERP integrations and queryable accounting preferences are related features, not documentation of this capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run multiple legal entities and currencies in one account with consolidated reporting and per-entity books
